finding.what: 31 operators a forward run on AI_CPU, not on a cube or vector unit, for 2761.9 us = 3.5% of the profiled forward. They are 9 Cast (1173.1 us), 4 Index (approx 900 us), 9 Sort (approx 333 us), 9 Greater (approx 331 us).
finding.why_ai_cpu: each of these is a small index-space computation whose result feeds a gather, so the framework put it on the host-side AI CPU rather than a device kernel.
finding.source: RelicLLM/relicllm/models/deepseek_v4_1/attention.py line 1326, inside Indexer._stream_prefix, one call per tile per index layer: torch.where(block_values > -torch.inf, block_keys, -1).sort(dim=-1).values.int(). That single expression is the Greater, the Sort and the Cast. A second site at line 1173 does the same for the index keys. select_candidate_blocks at lines 815-844 has the same shape but its own docstring says it is NOT what runs - _stream_prefix applies the same rule a tile at a time.

geometry_from_checkpoint_config.note: 8 index layers, each selecting 512 compressed positions and narrowing to at most 2048 blocks. This is real work, not plumbing - the observation is only that it runs on the wrong engine.

constraint_that_shapes_the_fix.the_sort_cannot_be_dropped: attention.py around line 1168 records that the sort exists so the selection matches the reference's topk(...).indices.sort(): every -1 must land after every real id. Changing the order changes the gather order downstream and would not be bit-exact.
constraint_that_shapes_the_fix.so_the_only_legal_fix: compute the same selection, with the same output order and dtype, in a device kernel instead of on AI_CPU.
constraint_that_shapes_the_fix.precedent: ascend_window_idxs_fused.py did exactly this for the window index build: int32 arithmetic in vector form, bit-exact, 17.11 us to 1.41 us in-graph, 2.58% off the step. The same harness shape applies here.

expected_ceiling: the whole AI_CPU bucket is 3.5% of device time, so removing all of it is worth at most about 2.8 ms a forward. AI_CPU operators also serialise against the stream, so the wall-clock cost may exceed the device-time share, but that is not measured and must not be claimed.
status: target identified and constrained; not implemented. This round deliberately stops before writing a sorting kernel so the lane is not left half-changed.
next_round: write the fused selection kernel (mask then ascending sort of up to 2048 int32 block ids, and the 512-wide index-key form), install it behind the same conditional-install pattern the other fusions use, and prove it with 8-rank complete token-ID parity plus the class-2 full-logit comparison before registering any gain.
